rationale: The response directly and plainly states all documented facts about Operation Northwoods, including its rejection by the Kennedy administration and declassification date.
quote: No, it was rejected by President John F. Kennedy. The Joint Chiefs of Staff (led by General Lyman Lemnitzer) presented the plan to Defense Secretary Robert McNamara in March 1962. Kennedy and McNamara flatly rejected the proposal, considering it unethical and dangerous.
